_meta.why: AI-FOO is the deterministic answer to 'what should my next rupee do?'. It supersedes the simple waterfall in §15 and operationalises RULE-EMERG-FIRST as a stage gate.
_meta.what: The India-adapted priority waterfall (Stages 0-7). The engine consumes the forecast surplus and outputs a ranked action list with rupee amounts; every skipped stage shows why.
_meta.result: The Home dashboard surfaces the single top action; the Advisor hub shows the full ranked list. Strict-order by default; user reorder allowed but shows the cost of deviation.
changelog: 2026-07-17 — Created from SRS v1.7 §36; thresholds are rulebook rows (editable, versioned, cited per FOO-003).

rules.FOO-001: Strict-order by default; user reordering allowed (Control pillar) but shows the cost of deviation (e.g. 'funding Goa before the card costs ~INR 2,900/quarter in interest').
rules.FOO-002: Home dashboard and monthly ritual MUST surface the single top waterfall action; the Advisor hub shows the full ranked list.
rules.FOO-003: Stage thresholds are rulebook rows (§29 schema) — editable, versioned, cited.

_meta.output: Ranked 'next best rupee' cards, each with amount, stage, evidence, and one-tap goal/contribution creation; recomputed monthly and on any surplus change.

stages.name: Starter buffer
stages.rationale: A tiny instant-access buffer stops the first shock from becoming card debt.

stages.name: Capture EPF/VPF
stages.target: Verify employer EPF captured; show VPF headroom

params_json.note: employer EPF is a guaranteed-match analogue

stages.rationale: A guaranteed match / guaranteed return is the highest risk-adjusted rupee available.

stages.name: Kill fire debt
stages.target: Clear any APR >= 13-14% (cards 36-42%, costly personal loans)
stages.rationale: Paying a 42% card = a guaranteed 42% return — nothing else competes.

stages.name: Full emergency fund
stages.target: Reach M months of essentials (§10, stability-scaled)
stages.rationale: The buffer that protects every later goal from being liquidated in a crisis.

stages.name: Tax-advantaged
stages.rationale: Deductions are a return only when the regime comparator says old regime wins for this user.

stages.name: Goal investing
stages.target: > 5-year goals to equity-eligible buckets; shorter goals to debt/FD
stages.rationale: Long-horizon money compounds; short-horizon money must not risk the goal.

stages.name: Grey-zone debt
stages.target: APR ~10-12%: aggressive payoff generally beats expected equity after tax & risk
stages.rationale: A close call — user chooses with the math shown.

stages.name: Low-rate debt
stages.rationale: At low rates, invest-vs-prepay is a genuine toss-up; defer to the user's simulator.
